framework: Y Combinator Guide to Product Development (Michael Seibel)
cycleName: Cycle 1: YC Silent Launch, Full Platform Rebuild & Trilingual Action Funnels

goals.label: Goal 1: Acquisition & Core Action
goals.summary: Maximize 3-Min Operational Audit completions (/audit, /ru/audit, /tt/audit) and Live Masterclass registrations (/webinar, /ru/webinar, /tt/webinar).
targetMetrics: >=30% conversion from Webinar confirmation screen to starting /audit

goals.label: Goal 2: Activation & Commercial Conversion
goals.summary: Convert Audit & Intake leads (/intake/athlete, /intake/federation across EN/RU/TT) into booked 1-on-1 walkthroughs and closed sprints.
targetMetrics: 2 closed 48-Hour Quick-Fix Sprints or AI-Native Back-Office Retainers per month
100% response within 2 working days on /intake/athlete and /intake/federation

goals.label: Goal 3: Delivery Velocity & Retention (I4I Loop)
goals.summary: Standardize the Sprint hand-off, >=10 hrs/wk relief verification, and I4I peer referral loop.
targetMetrics: <=21 days from sprint kickoff to full credential hand-off
>=10 hours/week verified coach administrative time saved
>=1 peer club or diaspora business referral per completed sprint

items.title: Persist Silent Launch, Audit, Webinar & Athlete Intake submissions to Google Sheets + Apps Script
items.needToHave: Forward POST /api/launch-leads, /api/audit, /api/webinar/register, and /api/athlete-leads to the bound Google Sheet + Apps Script Web App with Gmail notifications.
items.niceToHave: Optional Prisma PostgreSQL fallback when DATABASE_URL is configured.
items.analyticsSpec: Rows logged in Google Sheets tabs (Silent_Launch_Leads, Audit_Diagnostics, Webinar_Registrations, Athlete_Intake).

items.title: 1-Click Webinar & Silent Launch to Audit Pre-fill Handoff (/webinar & / -> /audit)
items.needToHave: Pass name, email, and org from /webinar and Silent Launch confirmation CTAs to /audit and pre-populate contact inputs.
items.niceToHave: Preserve active locale (/ru/audit, /tt/audit) across the handoff.
items.analyticsSpec: Share of audit_diagnostics with source='webinar-confirmation' or 'silent-launch' divided by total leads (Target >= 30%).

items.title: Channel & Locale Attribution Capture (source / locale) on /, /webinar, /intake/*, and /audit
items.needToHave: Add optional source/locale fields to LaunchLeadCreate, AuditSubmission, and WebinarRegistration zod contracts.
items.analyticsSpec: Conversion breakdown across en, ru, tt, silent-launch, federation-intake, and webinar-page.

items.title: Inline Field-Level 400 Error Mapping on /audit, /webinar, /intake/athlete, and /intake/federation
items.needToHave: Map 400 validation field errors inline on all interactive forms.
items.niceToHave: Localized validation feedback across EN, RU, and TT.
items.analyticsSpec: Zero 400 validation drop-offs where mobile users fail to retry.

items.title: Convert /intake/federation from static mailto to persisted trilingual API form
items.needToHave: Create FederationIntakeForm (src/components/custom/intake/federation-form.tsx) submitting to POST /api/launch-leads with Google Sheets + Gmail persistence.
items.niceToHave: Full EN, RU, and TT localization.
items.analyticsSpec: Persisted institutional intake count in Silent_Launch_Leads tab.

items.title: Full Trilingual Parity (EN/RU/TT) & Flattened Canonical URLs Across All 38 Routes (114 URLs)
items.needToHave: Flatten canonical URLs to root (with permanent 308 redirects from /portfolio/*) and localize /audit, /pricing, /intake/athlete, /intake/federation, and /webinar in EN, RU, and TT.
items.niceToHave: Branch-specific #branch-actions funnel blocks at the bottom of /a4a, /p4p, and /i4i.
items.analyticsSpec: 114 canonical routes indexed in /sitemap.xml; localized conversion tracking.

qaChecklist.check: Vertical hero sequence, Bulachak motto, 3 named branches (A4A, P4P, I4I), co-opetition copy, and top-nav CTAs (/audit, /#connect).
All 3 engagement pillars, 6-vertical playbooks, 4% P4P reciprocity banner, and editorial design unification.
Valid club inputs return Readiness/Friction Score (0-100), primary bottleneck, recommended tier, and Google Sheets persistence.
Registration confirmation card renders, .ics calendar file downloads cleanly, Concierge FAQ toggles work, and /audit CTA pre-fills registrant details.
5-field trilingual form validates inputs and persists to Athlete_Intake tab in Google Sheets.
5-field trilingual institutional briefing form validates inputs and persists to Silent_Launch_Leads tab in Google Sheets.

qaChecklist.surface: Flattened Canonical URLs, 308 Redirects & UI Invariants (/, /about, /work, /portfolio -> 308, /health)
qaChecklist.check: 114 localized routes, 308 redirects from /portfolio/*, /health returns 200, zero pill-shaped UI elements, and zero-orphan typography.
